Note on the finding itself: db.js's dbDeleteComment intentionally lets a recipe owner delete comments left by other users on their own recipe (comment at db.js:362: "a comment can be removed by whoever wrote it or by the owner of the recipe"). Reproduced 3/3 with primary class CROSS_ACCOUNT_ACCESS.
</dup_check>
